summary.text: Craig Hickman is a Democratic state senator who has represented Maine Senate District 14 since March 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A farm owner, he served in the Maine House from 2012 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Hickman graduated from Rufus King High School in 1986 and earned a bachelor's degree in government from Harvard University in 1990.
His career experience includes owning and operating Annabessacook Farm.
Hickman represented House District 81 from 2012 to 2020 and assumed office in the Maine State Senate on March 10, 2021.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee, which he chairs, and to the Conduct and Ethics Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
